name: Spreading Fire
disable: DC 17 Athletics check to splash the barrels of gall ink on the fire or DC 15 Survival check to smother the flames
routine: (1 action) On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies, with a minimum of 1 square. You determine the squares the fire spreads into—typically those with the most flammable materials. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 4d6 fire damage. Both of these have a DC 17 basic Reflex save save. A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

items.name: Spreading Flames
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the printing house

---
Effect The flames swell at the influx of air and deal 1d6 fire damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save). The fire then rolls initiative.

text: A fire engulfs a 5-foot-by-5-foot area, then spreads on each of its turns.
